+title: Static form of a Markdown row with math shows the TeX source
+---
+Found on 2026-11-26 during ^v2nh2hq.
+
+EditorKit ^tg1hnz7 measures inline and block math, so `EditorLayoutTranscriptTextMeasure` takes a Markdown part with math for exact. The cache then gives the row its height, and the row can show its static form (`StaticEditorSlot` with `StaticMarkdownText`). `StaticMarkdownText` shows strong, emphasis, inline code and links in SwiftUI `Text`, but it has no math support. Thus, while the rows move, a row with math shows the TeX source (for example `$\frac{a}{b}$`) in place of the formula. The height of the row is correct, but the text in the rows is not the text of the real form.
+
+## What
+- [ ] Check the look of the static form of a row with inline math and with block math (snapshot of the real view).
+- [ ] Decide: show math in the static form (for example a typeset image from EditorKit), or keep the real form for a row with math.
+- [ ] Add a test that fails when the static form of a row with math differs from the real form.
+
+#bug
